about_the_game:
Fight versus infinite hordes of lizards in post-soviet environment.

In this survivors-like game you will dive in different post-soviet places which are attacked by the ancient lizard's army. Pick your party, slay lizards, upgrade your weapons and characters, slay more lizards much effectively!

Features:

  • Two game modes:

    • Exploration mode with relatively long sessions to explore large cities and finding new playable characters and more powerful upgrades for them

    • Waves mode with short waves and tons of monsters you need to fight for unlocking new weapon parts which will make your weapons stronger or even completely different

  • Party system, you do not need to stay all by yourself, only if you like it

  • Many different characters with unique weapons on all of them, try to combine them rationally to have a balanced party without weaknesses

  • Weapon customization system

  • Character customization system

  • Different types of enemies and intimidating bosses
